scripts.text: - You hear a faint conversation going on inside. -

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Once again, I have failed to
make the ^8B4513Jaty Crown^000000...
I was sure that I could do it this time.
Why won't it work?

[Sage Kasyapa]
The ^006400Jaty Crown^000000 has been known to have miraculous power since the time of the ancients.
But it's been said only those who've earned a tribal honor
would be able to use it.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
^0000FFKasyapa^000000!!
Are you saying that even though I am the leader of our tribe, I have not yet received that honor?

[Sage Kasyapa]
Calm down ^0000FFChief Paiko^000000...
As the Great and Powerful Chief, you should be more than enough to qualify.

[Sage Kasyapa]
In my younger years I could have easily solved the problem but this old man's mind cannot figure out what's missing.
The conversation trails off and you don't hear any more.
Kasyapa and Chief Paiko begin talking as you are about to leave...

[Sage Kasyapa]
I am unsure of what is missing but that traveler could be big help in creating the ^006400Jaty Crown^000000.
Of this I am certain.
The reason is...

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
What is the reason?

[Sage Kasyapa]
This ^8B4513Cendrawasih Feather^000000 was owned by our first tribe leader when the crown was originally created.
It was stored as a treasured heirloom of our tribe.

[Sage Kasyapa]
But when the traveler came near, this feather started to shine, and I kept thinking that this is not just a coincidence.
This person will be the key to assisting us to make the crown.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Could it happen for sure?
If so, I will give everything
to support them...

[Sage Kasyapa]
Ah, a stranger to our land.
Are you lost?
I hope you did not encounter much danger on your journey here.

[Sage Kasyapa]
Your earnest expression tells me
that you have something to say
you might as well tell me what it is.
I overheard talk about a crown?
Just looking for the gift shop.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Really?
It looked as if your eyes
wanted to say something.

[Sage Kasyapa]
Oh, you heard about the crown, eh?
Ah, this old man's got loose lips
we should have used a little more discretion...
Anything I can do to help?

[Sage Kasyapa]
I can see in your eyes
that you are a trustworthy sort... but...
There is a brief twinkling of light ^0000FFKasyapa^000000 all of sudden seems to be taken aback.

[Sage Kasyapa]
Ah, the feather......!
Instead of talking to me, why don't you talk to our tribe's leader, ^0000FFPaiko^000000.

[Sage Kasyapa]
Instead of talking to me, why don't you talk to our tribe's leader, ^0000FFChief Paiko^000000.

[Sage Kasyapa]
If that's what Chief ^0000FFPaiko^000000 wants
I don't have any more to say.
Hmm....
but...... this....

[Sage Kasyapa]
Never mind, please have a good trip.

[Sage Kasyapa]
I've been waiting for you traveler.
Our tribe's leader has a favor
to ask of you.
Please talk to Chief ^0000FFPaiko^000000.

[Sage Kasyapa]
I heard you could help making a crown
for our tribe leader.
You will certainly be
a big help to us...
I trust my own eyes!
And also the sparkling light...

[Sage Kasyapa]
The symbol of Dayak Tribe
and a famous mystical creature.
Find 15 of ^006400Cendrawasih Feather^000000
and bring them to Chief ^0000FFPaiko^000000.

[Sage Kasyapa]
With the feathers that you have brought creating a ^006400Jaty Crown^000000 is going much more smoothly.
Go see Chief ^0000FFPaiko^000000.

[Sage Kasyapa]
There is something
I wish to give to you
as a reward for your help.
Please, it would honor us if you would take it.

[Sage Kasyapa]
You are carrying too much weight over the limit.
I cannot get you your reward unless you reduce the amount of weighty items you are carrying.

[Sage Kasyapa]
You are carrying too much in your inventory.
I will give you the reward once you unburden yourself and return.

[Sage Kasyapa]
The reason I asked you to embark on this important mission is because of this feather.
Handed down from generation to generation the legendary origin of the crown is this feather...

[Sage Kasyapa]
I saw this feather begin to shine when you came here.
I knew you were a person who
would endeavour to help us.
On behalf of my people
I give my thanks.

[Sage Kasyapa]
Also, the feather you received isn't just valuable on its own, it also is an acknowledgment from our tribe.

[Sage Kasyapa]
Like ^8B4513Krakatau^000000 Volcano, when you venture into dangerous areas like that, if you display this feather, you can get help from the tribe.
Anyway, I really thank you.

[Sage Kasyapa]
Also, the feather you received isn't just valuable on its own, it also is an acknowledgment from our tribe.

[Sage Kasyapa]
Like ^8B4513Krakatau^000000 Volcano, when you venture into dangerous areas like that, if you display this feather, you can get help from the tribe.
Anyway, I really thank you.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
I am the leader of this tribe
^0000FFPaiko^000000

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
I can see you are a traveler,
from another land.
What brings you here?
I overheard the story by accident
I have nothing to say.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
You are wasting your time here.
There are many other attractions around our village.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
What do you mean?
You heard the story about a crown?
You must have heard incorrectly.
I have nothing to say to you
regarding such things.
Kasyapa was talking about a crown...

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
It seems that ^0000FFKasyapa^000000 has told you a tall tale and I appreciate your concern about our affairs.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
It's not something that a stranger like you could understand so make like a tree, and get out of here.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
There are many other attractions around our village.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
If it's about the crown I want you to stop asking about it.
Please leave.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
I've been waiting for you, traveler
according to sage ^0000FFKasyapa^000000
You are willing to help us make a crown for our tribe.
Crown-a-whatsis?

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
The Tribe leader has the duty of making and protecting the ^006400Jaty Crown^000000 to uphold the tribe's pride and honor.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
But, ever since I became the tribe leader there have been difficulties making it.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
According to Sage ^0000FFKasyapa^000000, you can help us create a ^006400Jaty Crown^000000.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Do you think you can help?
Your efforts will not go unrewarded.
Ok, I will help
I am sorry, I cannot help now.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
That's really sad.
If you ever change
your mind, please
come again.
I will be waiting.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Many thanks to you, stranger
If Kasyapa trusts you then I know that you can help us make a
^006400Jaty Crown^000000
What you can do to
help us is very simple.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
The symbol of the Jaty Tribe is also a famous mystical creature.
Find 15 ^006400Cendrawasih Feather^000000s and bring them to me.
Our faith is in you, stranger.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
It seems that you have yet to find the materials to make the ^006400Jaty Crown^000000.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
The symbol of the Dayak Tribe is also a famous mystical creature.
Find 15 ^006400Cendrawasih Feather^000000s and bring them to me.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Oh! You've found all of them. Look! The feathers you have found are sparkling. Aren't they?
Alright, let me begin crafting the ^006400Jaty Crown^000000 I feel that I am ready.
Suddenly, a large noise begins to boom as you and ^0000FFPaiko^000000 are surrounded by warm and bright sparkling energy like a thousand tinkling fireflies.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
With your help the ^006400Jaty Crown^000000 is coming along nicely.
It will take some time until the task is finished so please wait a little.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
After the ^006400Jaty Crown^000000 is complete, there is a gift that I want to give to you.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Ah, also you should go see Sage ^0000FFKasyapa^000000 who really wants to reward you with something.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Ah, you should talk to Sage ^0000FFKasyapa^000000 who really wants to reward you with something.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
With your support I am not worrying about creating the ^006400Jaty Crown^000000.
I really appreciate it.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
A delightful day like today should be celebrated. Don't you think?
So I prepared to sample the special food of our tribe, called ^006400Satay^000000

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
But, this ^006400Satay^000000 is too tasty for just the two of us to share so we would like to share it with people out in the village.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
What do you think?
In order to share news that
the ^006400Jaty Crown^000000 is being successfully crafted and to share the delicious ^006400Satay^000000 with our friends, I need your help.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Are you up for a short delivery job?
Of course, I can help
Sorry, I am too busy to help.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
I believed you would definitely help me...
It's a little disappointing.
If you ever change your mind
come speak with me again.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Oh!, I knew you'd help.
Our tribe's warriors come to my mind before we share with anyone else.
Please share Satay with the warriors in the village.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
For the moment I will give you 2 ^006400Satay^000000.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
You may be tempted by the aroma of our ^006400Satay^000000 and you may eat one but, if you eat more than that you won't be able to share the ^006400Satay^000000
with our village friends.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Our tribe warriors come to my mind to deliver the food to share Satay with warriors in the village.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Ah, the next person whom I want the ^006400Satay^000000 delivered to is someone who stays across from the river, the ^0000FFTribe Manager^000000.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
To this end, I will give you 2 more servings of ^006400Satay^000000.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
If you are attracted by the aroma of the ^006400Satay^000000, you may eat one but, if you eat more you won't be able to share ^006400Satay^000000 with our friends.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Second person to be delivered ^006400Satay^000000 is someone who stays across the river.

That is the ^0000FFTribe Manager^000000.
Please deliver it to them before it cools down.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Oh, you have delivered it already?
The third person to deliver the ^006400Satay^000000 to is the ^0000FFGatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano^000000.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
I'll give you 2 more servings of ^006400Satay^000000 for this delivery.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
And just like before, don't give into the smell and try not to eat the ^006400Satay^000000.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
The third person to deliver the ^006400Satay^000000 to is the ^0000FFGatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano^000000.
Please deliver it before it cools down.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Oh, You have delivered it
Last person to deliver ^006400Satay^000000 to is the ^0000FFBorobudur Temple Manager^000000 who is on ^8B4513Dewata Island^000000.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
I will give you 2 more ^006400Satay^000000

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
And just like before, don't give into the smell and try not to eat the ^006400Satay^000000.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
The last person to be delivered ^006400Satay^000000 is
^0000FFBorobudur Temple Manager^000000 who is in
^8B4513Dewata Island^000000.
Please deliver it before it cools down.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Oh, you have delivered it.
You've done good work.
It has been a good time for all of us to share and enjoy this happy occasion together. Thank you.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
While you were on the way back from delivering the ^006400Satay^000000,
the Jaty Crown has been made. Its ambience and radiance make it a truly flawless crown.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Also, you brought more than enough materials so after making the ^006400Jaty Crown^000000, we were able to craft a similar one for you to keep.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
It's not the same as the original, but it has its own specialty. It is my reward to thank you for what you have done.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
You are carrying too much weight to receive your reward.
Please reduce your carried weight and come back again.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Made with our tribe's secret marinade try the ^006400Satay^000000.
It was made with all our heart, especially for you, but don't forget to share it with friends.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
You've done good work.
Whatever you do in the future, I wish for you to have a life which is full of fortune and joy.
As Chief of the ^8B4513Jaty Tribe^000000, I wish you the best of luck!!

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Haven't you delivered the ^006400Satay^000000 yet?
Anything go wrong?

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
It seems that you have yet to deliver the ^006400Satay^000000.
Did you run into any problems?
I ate them all.
Deliver to whom.
Nothing.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Huh... so you couldn't resist yourself, eh?
Don't blame yourself too much. It is difficult to resist the ^006400Satay^000000's addicting aroma.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Our tribe is short on food supplies so we can't give out more of our ^006400Satay^000000, but there's a rumor that the restaurant owner in Dewata Island is making and selling their own ^006400Satay^000000.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
It is not as tasty as our tribe's recipe, but this is an urgent task so just find it and deliver it.

[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Alright! Deliver it right now!

[Jaty Tribe Warrior]
We revere strength and bravery.
We are ^FF0000Jaty^000000 Tribe.

[Jaty Tribe Warrior]
My trained eyes see that
you seem about to say something.
Speak, and state your business.
^0000FFTribal Chief Paiko^000000

[Jaty Tribe Warrior]
I've heard about your
helpful deeds...
As a representative of my tribe
I express my thanks to you.

[Jaty Tribe Warrior]
Also, thank you for the ^006400Satay^000000
My mouth is already watering thank you.
There is something I would like to share with you regarding our tribe.

[Jaty Tribe Warrior]
Unlike the ancient times when our tribe's warriors fought and shed their blood the world has become more peaceful nowadays but our tribe's territory has shrunk drastically.

[Jaty Tribe Warrior]
Nevertheless we will continue keeping the warrior tradition of our tribe alive and we will preserve the pride we have earned through the sacrifice of those past warriors.

[Jaty Tribe Warrior]
I hope that your perseverance and pride remain with you in your travels.

[Tribe Manager]
Keeping our culture and tradition is very important.

[Tribe Manager]
Keeping our culture and tradition is very important.
Although it is a little boring...

[Tribe Manager]
It seems to me that you have something
to say, don't you?
^0000FFTribal Chief Paiko^000000

[Tribe Manager]
I didn't know that there was
such an effort being put forth
and that you took a key role in the effort...
You are the hero of the^8B4513Jaty Tribe^000000.

[Tribe Manager]
Wow~ the savory scent of
delicious homemade ^006400Satay^000000!!
Thank you for the meal.
Please give my regards
to our Tribe Leader.

[Tribe Manager]
There are few contacts between
^8B4513Dewata Island^000000 and ^8B4513Jaty tribe^000000.
We used to have a stronger bond
in older times.

[Tribe Manager]
But with new culture and foreigners flowing in
^8B4513Dewata Island^000000 has became a tourist attraction and we have lost touch with them.

[Tribe Manager]
The tourist attraction has expanded continuously but the reason it hasn't influenced us here is due to this small temple which I am managing.

[Tribe Manager]
I couldn't let our tradition fade away like that easily.
I hope keeping our tradition and culture alive lets people know how important these things are to us.

[Tribe Manager]
From now on, I hope people from ^8B4513Dewata Island^000000 and ^8B4513Jaty Tribe^000000 can get along and interact more often.

[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
^8B4513Krakatau Volcano^000000 is
a very dangerous area
I cannot allow anyone to go in there.
Allow me through
I don't want to go in{0}

[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
^8B4513Krakatau Volcano^000000 is
a very dangerous area
so I can't allow you in
unless you qualify for entry.

[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
You are the traveler who was acknowledged by tribe leader as a friend of the tribe and received a ^006400Shining Cendrawasih Feather^000000.

[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
Well, I will let you pass but ^8B4513Krakatau Volcano^000000 is dangerous so please take care.

[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
You have chosen wisely.
^8B4513Krakatau Volcano^000000 is
an extremely dangerous area.

[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
Oh! I didn't know about that!
This is some of the best news
I have heard recently.

[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
Um, what is this wonderful smell?
Of course, it's our ^006400Satay^000000!
I was slightly hungry
so this should fill me up.

[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
Since you came all the way here
I will share you an interesting story.

[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
It has become a lost tradition in recent years but until 10 or more years ago in order to become a ^8B4513Jaty Tribe^000000 warrior you had to climb Krakatau Volcano to prove your endurance.

[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
The eyes of those warriors were anxious yet determined before going up ^8B4513Krakatau Volcano^000000.

[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
I still cannot forget that look in their eyes I feel a little bit the same emotion from you Adventurer.

[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
I want you to live long and prosper.
Be healthy and safe, traveler so you can live to tell the tale of your adventures.

[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
Want to go back
to Dewata?
Yes
No

[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
^8B4513Krakatau Volcano^000000 is
a dangerous place.
You should go back now.

[Borobudur Temple Manager]
The weather today is so beautiful.

[Borobudur Temple Manager]
By the way, do you have
something to tell me...?
^0000FFTribal Chief Paiko^000000

[Borobudur Temple Manager]
I never knew such a thing had happened.
If you had told me in advance, I could have helped at least a little bit.
Still things have gone well with your help.

[Borobudur Temple Manager]
Ah, it is the ^006400Satay^00000 that I sampled when the tribe invited me some time ago.

[Borobudur Temple Manager]
Good~~ This is the same taste I remember.
To give my thanks I will pass along a story that may interest you

[Borobudur Temple Manager]
Legend tells of a strange bird called ^FF0000Garuda^000000.
It has the torso, arms and legs of a human but has the head and beak of an eagle.

[Borobudur Temple Manager]
The Story of this bird describes it helping the gods exterminate wicked demons and snakes.

[Borobudur Temple Manager]
The tale has been passed down from generation to generation.
Quite interesting, isn't it?

[Borobudur Temple Manager]
I am sure in the village of the ^8B4513Jaty Tribe^000000 there are many legendary stories.
When I get to meet the Chief, I will hear many such stories for sure.

[Borobudur Temple Manager]
I am not certain of when we will cross paths again but I hope we will meet again someday.
I wish you a pleasant journey, young traveler.

[Memo]
Why are you carrying so much? Doesn't that hurt your back?

[Memo]
Is it a trend for youngsters to carry heavy things?

[Memo]
Will you help me again tomorrow?
Poby still has a back pain.
Backaches don't just go away after one day.

[Memo]
Dewata is always crowded but today is quiet.

[Memo]
Oh god! We don't have a message from the Jaty tribe yet.

[Memo]
They have never broken a promise for 10 years, I do not know the reason. What's happening?

[Memo]
I might spoil all the liquid if it is going on like this.

[Memo]
What should I do? I still don't have any news from the Jaty tribe.

[Memo]
Oh no~ All the liquid is going to spoil...
What happened?

[Memo]
Who are you?

[Memo]
You are an adventurer, right?
As you can see from the jars around me, I am making ^0000FFtraditional wine^000000 for a living.

[Memo]
Everyone knows about this, so ^0000FFDewata island^000000 attracts many tourists.

[Memo]
Especially this traditional wine, which has been made for four generations! But ^FF0000Ark^000000 is short of supply.
Ark needs ^0000FFPalm Oils^000000, made from Oil Palm Fruit.

[Memo]
Unfortunately, we haven't been getting ^0000FFPalm Oil^000000 from the Jaty tribe village lately.
The ingredients might be useless if it is delivered too late.
Sounds like a big problem.

[Memo]
It is more of a problem than you think. Sales are credit, but if we do not make due today, we'll lose the credit, the ingredients, and the tourists who do not get the Ark. So it's quite damaging.

[Memo]
Ah, right! Are you busy now?
Sorry, I am busy.
No, I am not busy.

[Memo]
Hmm, I have no choice.
You don't care that others are in trouble. What has this world come to?

[Memo]
That's good to hear.
So since you are wandering here...

[Memo]
Do you mind if I ask you a favor~? Actually I have to visit the Jaty Tribe, but this unmatured ^FF0000Ark^000000 won't let me leave.

[Memo]
Will you go to Jaty village and ask ^0000FFLero^000000 what happened?

[Memo]
This guy has never broken a promise for 10 years, so he must have a really good reason not to come.

[Memo]
Find the best oil master.
His name again is ^0000FFLero^000000.

[Memo]
So, what did Lero say?

[Memo]
You didn't find out what happened?

[Memo]
Find the best oil master. His name is ^0000FFLero^000000.

[Memo]
So, what did Lero say?
Palm tree... became.
- You explain the situation to Mr. Memo -

[Memo]
Lero said sorry?
Hmm, it's okay.

[Memo]
That must be ^0000FFPoby^000000. If he has been hurt, that's why there wasn't any message. Lero actually cares about him a lot...

[Memo]
He might be troublesome, but please visit the Jaty village. Lero must complete the oil.

[Memo]
If it is not, wait there and bring ^FF000030 bottles of oil^000000 to me.

[Memo]
He might be troublesome, but please visit the Jaty village. Lero must complete the oil.

[Memo]
If it is not, wait there and bring ^FF000030 bottles of oil^000000 to me.

[Memo]
Oh, didn't I tell you to bring 30 bottles of oil? Did you forget?

[Memo]
Go back to Lero and get more, he will give you more if it was your mistake.

[Memo]
You brought the oil. Good job, and thank you.

[Memo]
Excuse me, but I have an urgent matter to attend to. Can you wait for a while and talk to me when I'm done?
- Memo is making an ark. -
- There is error in the quest. -

[Memo]
Did I make you wait too long?

[Memo]
My family has been making Arks for four generations.

[Memo]
Grandfather had a hard living since he didn't get many good sales.

[Memo]
Dewata island people do not drink much in the hot weather.

[Memo]
When I was young, Dewata developed as a tourist attraction and that's when the ^FF00FFtour package^000000 Ark started selling well.

[Memo]
Good liquid needs fresh oil. I was able to make liquid for ten years and deliver it all on time.

[Memo]
Because today's oil has not arrived on time, I think I might have a hard time.

[Memo]
You helped me to make the liquid correctly.

[Memo]
This proverb ^0000FF'Mengatakan mudah, mengerjakan susah.'^000000 means it is easy to say something but hard to do anything.

[Memo]
In other words, it's easy to say that we'll help others but it's hard to actually do the action.

[Memo]
You really did a great job. I like you because you are different from today's youngins.

[Memo]
Will you help me with my work from time to time?
I will pay you for what you do for me.

[Memo]
{0}, to what do I owe the pleasure?
Just came by to say hello.
I will help you.

[Memo]
I guess you are busy.
If possible, will you get the oil from Lero? I will appreciate it...

[Memo]
Thank you. I know that you're busy and helping me can be a chore.

[Memo]
Can you help Lero and bring back palm tree oil...?

[Memo]
Can you help Lero and bring back palm tree oil...?

[Memo]
You haven't brought enough oil.

[Memo]
Poby owes me a few things, he'll give you some.

[Memo]
Oh you brought the oil, good job.

[Memo]
You must've had a hard time bringing the oil so here take this drink.

[Memo]
Ark is famous for tourists, a guy bought many bottles by himself.

[Memo]
Worrying that he'll drink alone? Too much drink always becomes poisonous.

[Memo]
The sun always rises in the East. The well known laziness wakes up early in the morning.

[Memo]
Does he come to reality? He is good but lazy.

[Memo]
The first blow is half the battle.

[Memo]
I think that you're destined to do great things.

[Memo]
There's a man saying blow hot and cold, it seems that a word is easy but it is not.

[Memo]
I believe that you will hold true to your promise.

[Memo]
I want you to help me this time.

[Memo]
Poby still has back pains and it will take some days for him to recover.

[Memo]
Dewata island is always crowded but today is quiet.

[Lero]
You're carrying too many things...

[Lero]
Oh no! I have so many orders and I'm running out of ingredients.
Not yet? What's going on, Poby? Where did he go?
Excuse me, but are you Lero?

[Lero]
When Poby gets back here, I'm gonna give him a beating he'll never forget!
- Lero seems pretty mad at someone and ignores you -

[Lero]
Oops. Who are you?
Memo sent me here.

[Lero]
Ah, right! I forgot about Memo because the workers who gather nuts have not come yet. Sorry.

[Lero]
To make fresh palm oils, I need fresh Palm Oil Fruit. Then I'll be able to get more fresh oil from its fresh fruit.

[Lero]
Between you and me, Mr. Memo is so fussy that he will not use any unfresh oil.

[Lero]
To make fresh oil, he always sends the workers to palm tree forest, but... the guys sent at dawn have not come back yet.

[Lero]
First, I thought that he was lazy and it made me very uneasy.
Can you find the workers in the palm forest?
Yes, I will find them.

[Lero]
Thank you so much.
Find Poby.

[Lero]
Poby might in ^0000FFPalm Forest^000000. The crop is best at the southern part of the forest.

[Lero]
Did you find Poby?
